2.message:
fix(1.8): silently skip mobs unavailable on the running MC version

EntityType.valueOf threw for every 1.9+-only mob name (DROWNED, EVOKER,
FOX, ...) configured in mobs.yml, logging a per-mob WARNING flood on
1.8.8 boot (17x). Narrow the catch to IllegalArgumentException and
drop the log call - the mob's soul jar simply isn't registered on
versions where it doesn't exist.
2.author: intisy (Finn Birich)

7.message:
ci: call the shared test workflow instead of the org ci workflow

 - the org workflow set up a gradle cache, which then held the remote convention script for 24h and needed a cache-eviction step of its own; the shared workflow sets up no cache, so the script is fetched fresh every run
